description: This PHP class defines the BasicWorkSchedule implementation for managing employee work schedules, including work shift times and holiday considerations within the OrangeHRM HR management system.

classes.name: BasicWorkSchedule
classes.description: Implements work schedule management, providing methods to determine work hours, shifts, and holiday statuses for employees.

methods.name: getWorkShiftService
methods.description: Returns the WorkShiftService instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employee number associated with this schedule.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for the schedule.

methods.name: getWorkShiftLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the work shift in hours, either from employee data or default config.

methods.name: getWorkShiftStartEndTime
methods.description: Returns the start and end times of the work shift for the employee.

methods.name: isNonWorkingDay
methods.description: Checks whether the given day is a non-working day.

methods.name: isHalfDay
methods.description: Determines if the given day is a half working day.

methods.name: isHoliday
methods.description: Checks whether the given day is a holiday.

methods.name: isHalfDayHoliday
methods.description: Checks whether the given day is a half-day holiday.
